reference_headings.heading: Choose a workflow and establish boundaries

synthesis_records.rule: Check installed edition/build, available commands/devices and actual tool support before planning; prefer preserved source/new-track operations.
Check one monitoring path, meter activity, selected tap and test-recorded timing rather than blindly shifting clips or duplicating monitoring.
Audit custom routes, Pre-send mute behavior, cue/Main isolation and hardware resync response; preserve default-disabled feedback.
Preserve originals/alternates, compare source and output without doubling, check fade/transient boundaries and avoid inferring single/merged stem settings from grouped output.
Ordered diagnostic checklist integrates routing, monitor, mapping, latency, render-stage, comp and load dependencies. It is not a report of actual testing.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: Assigned chapters do not state exact minimum Live minor versions or edition entitlements for Bounce, Stem Separation, External Instrument or Max for Live.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime requires checking installed feature/device availability and makes no fabricated version/edition guarantee. Parent may add separately verified availability evidence.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: Seven crossfader curves are stated in text, but curve names, plotted power levels and detailed response relationships appear only in unextracted graphics.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime preserves the seven-curve selector and A/B semantics, asks to inspect/audition response, and does not invent names, center gain, slopes or numerical curve values. Figure inspection remains for the parent if exact curve specifications are required.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: Source varies between Keep Monitoring Latency in Recorded Audio, Record Audio, Recording and the track-toggle heading.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime uses Recorded Audio plus the shorter Recording label and specifies the In/Auto context-menu access; installed UI spelling remains unverified.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: Effects/track-automation destination is described as a new Group Track, but single-family and merged results have no group. Their exact destination/inheritance is not explained.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime states inheritance for grouped results and requires inspection for single/merged results; no destination is guessed.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: A general sentence associates Warp Markers with audio or MIDI recordings, without a MIDI Warp Marker procedure.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime restricts Warp Marker guidance to audio and refers MIDI timing to MIDI editing/Quantize, which is explicitly supported in 19.5; no new MIDI-warp UI is invented.

gaps_and_uncertainties.gap: Assigned bounce text does not specify tail handling, bounce sample format/rate/depth or exhaustive behavior for every custom feedback route.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime states documented tap stages and routing exclusions only; output extent and routing are verification requirements, not asserted guarantees.
